subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Which single public metadata field name and cross-channel scope should OpenClaw accept for channel group config entries?
rationale: This changes the public configuration contract, and repository policy favors one canonical current config shape rather than aliases or per-channel drift.

options.title: Adopt `name` everywhere
options.body: Use one optional `name?: string` metadata field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, docs, generated metadata, and config tooling while keeping it runtime-ignored.

options.title: Choose another canonical field
options.body: Use a different single field such as `label` or `description`, but apply it consistently across the same public config surfaces.

options.title: Decline config metadata
options.body: Keep group entries behavior-only and leave readability to external notes, UI display labels, or channel-provided names.

recommendation.title: Adopt `name` everywhere
recommendation.body: Use one optional `name?: string` metadata field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, docs, generated metadata, and config tooling while keeping it runtime-ignored.

likelyOwner.reason: The central config schema history and prior review context make steipete the clearest owner for this public config-contract choice.
